title: Reserve step 5 — BCCR burns the fCeBM and mints tCeBM
description: Two chains move: the Besu burn of the fiat token and the Zeto/Paladin mint of the privacy token, each with its own hash.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc — the approve/reject/exchange half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a Central Bank gateway; a commercial-bank gateway answers 404. Scenario B names the Paladin-side hash mint_tx_hash. Scenario A's OpenAPI document calls the same field zeto_mint_tx_hash, but its delivered gateway also emits mint_tx_hash — see mocks/pvp/happy-path/06.
